scenarios.title: A forecast ability can be activated only from hand

setup.notes: Spirit en-Dal's forecast costs {1}{W}: target creature gains shadow until end of turn.

decisions: A checks whether the forecast ability of Spirit en-Dal can be activated targeting Grizzly Bears, with two Plains available.

variants.label: in_hand
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is legal.

variants.label: on_battlefield
variants.delta: Spirit en-Dal is on A's battlefield instead of in A's hand.
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is not legal.

operation.unclassifiable: moves the card to another zone

variants.label: in_graveyard
variants.delta: Spirit en-Dal is in A's graveyard instead of in A's hand.
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is not legal.

operation.unclassifiable: moves the card to another zone

detector.outcome: A hand-only ability candidate passes the zone check: its card is in its controller's hand.
detector.near_miss: A hand-only ability candidate fails the zone check: its card is in another zone.

scenarios.title: A forecast ability can be activated only during its owner's upkeep

setup.notes: Spirit en-Dal's forecast costs {1}{W}: target creature gains shadow until end of turn.

decisions: A checks whether the forecast ability of Spirit en-Dal can be activated targeting Grizzly Bears, with two Plains available.

variants.label: owner_upkeep
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is legal.

variants.label: draw_step
variants.delta: The step is draw instead of upkeep.
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is not legal.

variants.label: opponent_upkeep
variants.delta: B is the active player and it is B's upkeep.
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is not legal.

detector.outcome: An upkeep-only ability candidate passes the phase check during the upkeep step.
detector.near_miss: An upkeep-only ability candidate fails the phase check outside the upkeep step.

scenarios.title: A forecast ability can be activated only once each turn

setup.notes: Spirit en-Dal's forecast costs {1}{W}: target creature gains shadow until end of turn.

decisions: A checks whether the forecast ability of Spirit en-Dal can be activated targeting Grizzly Bears, with four Plains available.

variants.label: first_activation
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability is legal.

variants.label: second_activation
variants.delta: A already activated the forecast ability of Spirit en-Dal earlier this turn (two Plains are already tapped for it; two remain untapped).
variants.expected: Activating the forecast ability a second time this turn is not legal.

operation.unclassifiable: more than one fact: a prior activation and tapped lands

detector.outcome: A once-each-turn ability candidate passes the activation_limit check: it has not been activated this turn.
detector.near_miss: A once-each-turn ability candidate fails the activation_limit check after its first activation this turn.
